subject: general
question: A sum of Rs. 14500 will become Rs. 16675 in 36 months at some rate of simple interest. What is the rate of interest per annum?
solution:
Given:

Principal = 14,500

Time = 3 years

Amount = 16675

Formula Used:

SI = Amount - Principal

SI = (P × R × T)/100

where, SI = Simple interest, P = Principal, R = Rate and T = Time

Calculations:

SI = 16675 - 14500

SI = 2175

SI = PRT/100

⇒ 2175 = (14500 × R × 3)/100

⇒ R = (2175 × 100) / (14500 × 3)

⇒ R = (2175) / (145 × 3)

⇒ R = 5%

**∴ Rate of interest per annum is 5%.**
